dForce is a DeFi lending protocol. dForce operates on the Ethereum blockchain. dForce issues the USDx stablecoin.

SpiritSwap is a decentralized exchange. SpiritSwap operates as an automated market maker. SpiritSwap runs on the Fantom Opera network.

Opyn is a DeFi options protocol. Opyn runs on the Ethereum blockchain. Opyn issues options as tokenized contracts called oTokens.

OpenSea is an NFT marketplace. OpenSea enables trading of non-fungible tokens on public blockchains. OpenSea is operated by a company rather than purely by smart contracts.
